job.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering
job.pay_full: $164,000 – $229,000 a year base salary, plus equity (restricted stock units)

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with more than 100,000 active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. Its Infrastructure Engineering group gives Reddit's developers a reliable, automated foundation covering compute, deployments, storage and messaging. This one posting hires across several teams: Messaging (the asynchronous communication platform for all products and services), Site Defense (detecting and mitigating bots, scraping and abusive traffic) and Infrastructure Security (service identity, secrets management and secure access).
duties: Work with Product, Design, Data Science and client engineers to turn business and user needs into reliable, low-latency solutions
Own the full software lifecycle from design docs and API contracts to development, testing, rollout and observability
Design, build and evaluate A/B experiments, using tools like BigQuery, HEX or Firebase
Build scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services
Set engineering best practices, improve developer workflows and mentor teammates
Help select, scope and drive high-leverage projects
needs: 3+ years building internet-scale software, preferably in distributed systems infrastructure or infrastructure security
Software development in a general purpose language: Golang, Python, C++ or Java
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, GCP)
Hands-on work on features, optimizations and bug fixes in distributed messaging systems
Excellent communication skills with engineering, data science, machine learning and product stakeholders
Degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technical field
details.benefits: Base salary $164,000 – $229,000 a year; final offers depend on skills, experience and credentials. The job is eligible for equity in restricted stock units and, depending on the position, possibly commission. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) with employer match, income replacement programs, family planning support, gender-affirming care, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation, paid volunteer time off and paid parental leave.
notes: The posting may span more than one career level
